proofs.label: atomic_qualification_1
assertions: Actual claim-first atomic mint/transfer/custody and close, 64 position-ID vector, exact historical reward conservation and retained quarantine.

proofs.label: atomic_qualification_2
assertions: Independent borrowers, actual accrued debt fully funded and repaid atomically with permitted seizure; historical rewards retained and never waived.

proofs.label: atomic_qualification_3

proofs.label: atomic_qualification_4
assertions: Static-interest full repayment/release and receipt withdrawal during outage, then physical principal exit and exited-holder booked rewards; dynamic repayment is explicitly not qualified.

proofs.label: repayment_baseline_regression_reproduced
assertions: Existing amount-only route offers a maximum covering post-accrual debt but transfers the pre-accrual debt amount and leaves a positive interest residual. This expected regression does not qualify full repayment.
Debt-free release rejects that residual with complete ledger and TTL rollback; historical beneficiary entitlement and exact scaled reward conservation remain intact.

proofs.label: repayment_candidate_dynamic_full_repay_release
assertions: Isolated additive V3 full-repayment route handles eight independently aged dynamic debts, with exact maximum or transfer-and-refund maximum: actual token events and payer/receipt net balances equal returned post-accrual debt.

Every position reaches zero debt; a repeat before release returns zero without another debit; the existing authorized debt-free release and margin-to-spot custody route succeed while both upstream reward calls fail.

Historically booked beneficiary claims remain payable through outages; custody allocation clears after receipt exit; each unresolved interval remains quarantined without forced waiver; exact scaled reward conservation and zero custodian entitlement hold.

proofs.label: repayment_candidate_adversarial_rollback
assertions: Below-debt maximum, zero maximum, absent external authorization, wrong authorized owner and insufficient funds for the full maximum reject without any ledger or TTL changes; diagnostics prove the intended failure instead of setup rejection.

A subsequent sufficient full repayment clears post-accrual debt and permits release; full repayment and release after Position deletion reject with complete rollback. Exact scaled beneficiary reward conservation persists.
